name: Fairy Tale
summary: Fantasy card drafting and tableau-building game where players draft hands and play cards to build scoring sets.
rules_text: Remove expert cards. Shuffle 80-card deck. Game has 4 rounds. Each round has Draft then Play. Draft: deal 5 cards to each player face down. Simultaneously each player chooses 1 card to keep face down, then passes remaining hand left in rounds 1 and 3, right in rounds 2 and 4. Repeat until hands empty, keeping 5 drafted cards. Play: players have 5 cards, must play 3. Simultaneously select one, reveal together. When revealed, apply Unflip/Flip effects: Unflip turns your face-down cards face up, Flip turns face-up down. Effects state who, how many, and which faction. Apply all Unflips before Flips, specific factions first. After 3 plays, discard 2 unused face down. After 4 rounds each has 12 cards in tableau. Score only face-up cards, counting variable and Friends bonuses.
rating_reason: Card draft collection game with hidden hands sequential choice
